edits.new: The full rwb-case surface of sixteen operations is published in the service API file; this baseline documents the four operations the case-creation capability needs and keeps the shared components reusable for the rest. The task raise the capability needs (legacy `CaseWorkflowApi.raiseTask` with caseId, taskCode, ownerRole and reasonCode) is one of the remaining operations: its path is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1085) and is published in the service API file and recorded in the Ownership Map before the app story is built against it.
